notes: Actual results for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2024, as the municipality reported them to the Census Bureau's Annual Survey of State and Local Government Finances. Not a budget.
Public schools are run by separate school districts, and York County provides many other services; residents pay the city, the county and the school district.
Covers every fund, including water, sewer, electric and other utilities. Debt service counts interest and principal repaid; borrowing and transfers between funds are left out.
Courts, legal services, public buildings, housing and community development count as overhead.
Debt is long-term debt outstanding plus short-term debt at year end.

Political money counts contributions from businesses, unions and PACs to candidates for city council and mayor, filed with the State Ethics Commission since 2023. South Carolina allows business contributions. Individuals and party and candidate committees are not counted.
Transparency practices have not been checked yet, so they are not scored.

The Census surveys every government only in Census of Governments years (2022) and a sample in other years, so FY 2022 is the latest available.
Public schools are run by separate school districts, and York County provides many other services; residents pay the town, the county and the school district.
Covers every fund, including water, sewer, electric and other utilities. Debt service counts interest and principal repaid; borrowing and transfers between funds are left out.
Payments to other governments ($67,000) are left out, because the government receiving them reports that spending.
Courts, legal services, public buildings, housing and community development count as overhead.
Debt is long-term debt outstanding plus short-term debt at year end.

Political money counts contributions from businesses, unions and PACs to candidates for town council and mayor, filed with the State Ethics Commission since 2023. South Carolina allows business contributions. Individuals and party and candidate committees are not counted.
